_comment: This file is managed by the todo CLI. Do not edit it directly, by hand or with a script. Read it with todo: `todo next --json` (what to work on), `todo show --id <id|ref> --json` (one task), `todo list --flat` (every item as flat JSON records). Change it with todo commands (add, edit, move, status, assign, rm, ...; see `todo --help`), which keep its ids and rules valid.

tasks.title: Needs you: try the stack drag cases by hand in the browser
tasks.description: Only jsdom tests cover the drag; nobody dragged in a real browser (unattended run, no dev server). In npm run dev (or make run-ui) check: row widget into a stack (top, middle, end, empty stack); child out to another row and to the stack's own row; reorder within a stack; child from one stack to another; dragging a stack over another stack (no zone lights up); Escape during a stack drag and a row drag; child onto a full row (blocked guide, nothing happens); the nested sortables don't trigger each other; on a narrow screen, a stack scrolled out of view doesn't catch drops.

tasks.title: review new userauth capabilites for auth, e.g. PAT
Follow-up: check that viewer.css is regenerated
tasks.description:
From review: nothing guards against a template using Tailwind utilities that are missing from the committed internal/dashboard/browser/assets/viewer.css (e.g. focus-within:, placeholder: in the new search template); a check (make target or test) that make viewer-css produces no diff would catch it.

[next-iteration 2026-11-27]
Expert: all classes in search/browser.html are present in the committed viewer.css today; release.yml (lines 59, 150) already runs make viewer-css before building, so drift only affects make run (dev) and the committed file.
Needs you: add a drift guard (make viewer-css + git diff --exit-code) to make verify or the push/PR CI? It changes the project's gates and needs npm/Tailwind there. Options: (a) add it to make verify, (b) add it only to CI, (c) not needed since releases regenerate.
